title: The Girl From The Farm — EN/SN/ZU (Mbira Folk)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm female vocal 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona Zulu heritage resilience
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
She grew up watching seasons turn the red earth brown to green
The girl from the farm learned more than books could ever say or mean
Her hands knew soil before they knew a keyboard or a phone
The farm was not a place she left — it followed her back home

[Verse 2 — Shona, with English translation]
Musikana akakurira pamunda, akadzidza kubva pamvura
[The girl grew up on the farm, she learned from the rain]
Akachinja kukura semashizha epapfambi
[She changed and grew like leaves on the msasa tree]
Akabva kwake, asi munda wake wakamuramba
[She left her place, but her farm remained with her]
Musikana wepamunda, ane simba rechokwadi
[The girl from the farm has true strength]

[Chorus — English]
The girl from the farm
She carries the red dust in her veins
The girl from the farm
She thrives in sun and knows the rains
She left but the farm never left her
The land wrote her name in the clay

[Bridge — Zulu, with English translation]
Intombazane yasepulazini ikhulile kahle
[The girl from the farm grew up well]
Izandla zayo ziyazi umhlabathi
[Her hands know the soil]
Wahamba kodwa ulwandle lwabuyela kuye
[She went away but the land came back to her]
Intombazane yasepulazini, ihlala ikhona
[The girl from the farm, she always remains]

[Outro — All three languages]
The girl from the farm… Musikana wepamunda… Intombazane yasepulazini
The land never leaves — Munda hausi kumukana — Umhlabathi awuyeki
The gardens still growing
